description: All demand, output, and material quantities use pre-aggregated lot units mapped from KL, not raw volume semantics
resolution: The package README freezes the lot-size mapping per SKU

description: The current recipe model uses one fixed total duration per SKU and cannot vary packaging time by selected line speed
resolution: Keep conservative SKU durations in V1; add resource-dependent duration support later if required

description: InventoryBalance currently allows only one availability row per item, so opening stock and later replenishment are compressed into one net row per material item
resolution: If procurement simulation becomes critical, extend inventory events beyond the current single-row MVP

description: The source Snow Beer requirement provides shift rules but no dated maintenance windows; this package adds two explicit service windows only for downtime smoke
resolution: Keep the assumption visible in the package README and expected checks

description: Raw packaging-material lead times are compressed into in-horizon availableFromMinutes checkpoints so the current product behavior stays observable in one sample horizon
resolution: Treat the arrival timestamps as demo checkpoints, not literal 5/7/10/15-day procurement replay

description: Each packaging lot is intentionally split into PREP and PACK operations on the same candidate lines so the current precedence path can be validated on a Snow Beer-shaped sample
resolution: Use this package only for precedence-specific UAT and keep the base package for single-stage packaging walkthroughs
